title: Loan data intake & validation (note terms, remittance type A/A–S/A–S/S, escrow flags, MERS MIN)
deadline: Board before first post-transfer payment cycle

title: Servicing transfer approval from Fannie Mae
RESPA transfer notices (goodbye/hello)
deadline: Transferor ≥15 days before effective date; transferee ≤15 days after; combined notice ≥15 days before; 60-day late-fee grace (RESPA §6(d))

title: Loss-mit in-flight transfer handling
deadline: Continue prior deadlines; acknowledge within 10 days of transfer if ack period not expired

title: Accept & post periodic payment (P&I + escrow)
source: FNMA C-1.1-01; Reg Z 1026.36(c)(1) prompt crediting

title: Partial payment / suspense handling
deadline: Apply when suspense ≥ one full periodic payment

title: Late charge assessment
source: Note terms; Reg X 1024.33(c) (no late fee during 60-day transfer overlap)

title: Annual escrow analysis
deadline: Analysis at completion of computation year

title: Annual escrow account statement
deadline: Within 30 days of end of computation year

title: Cushion enforcement
deadline: Cushion ≤ one-sixth (2 months) of estimated annual disbursements

title: Surplus refund
deadline: Refund within 30 days if surplus ≥ $50 (borrower current); < $50 may credit

title: Shortage repayment
deadline: Shortage < 1 mo payment: allow / 30-day / ≥12-mo; shortage ≥ 1 mo: allow or ≥12-mo spread. No $50 threshold (surplus-only)

title: Notice of Error (NoE) resolution
trigger: On borrower NoE (any written assertion of error; ~event-driven, continuous)
deadline: Acknowledge ≤5 business days; respond ≤30 BD (+15 ext.); payoff-balance errors (1024.35(b)(6)) ≤7 BD; foreclosure errors before sale; no extension for (b)(6)/(9)/(10)

title: Request for Information (RFI)
trigger: On borrower RFI (any written request for information; continuous)
deadline: Acknowledge ≤5 BD; respond ≤30 BD (+15); owner/assignee identity ≤10 BD

title: Continuity of contact / assigned personnel
trigger: On delinquency (each delinquency episode; continuous availability thereafter)
deadline: Assign personnel by written-EI-notice date, in any event by 45th day of delinquency

title: Successor in interest
trigger: On death/transfer (notice from any source; continuous)

title: Complaint handling / UDAAP
trigger: Ongoing (every expression of dissatisfaction, any channel; regulator/investor referrals)

title: Loan Activity Report (LAR) submission
trigger: Monthly per loan (in practice: per processed transaction, plus a monthly "no activity" report)
deadline: LAR by 8pm ET next business day after processing; by 22nd calendar day regardless of payment

title: Remittance of P&I
trigger: Monthly (plus event-driven A/A remittances and special remittances)
deadline: S/A: funds available for draft by 20th; A/A auto-draft 2 business days after event processing (LL-2025-02); S/S per type

title: Stop Delinquency Advance handling
deadline: Fannie Mae suspends drafting delinquency advances after the 4th consecutive advance

title: Establish P&I custodial account (Form 1013)
trigger: On new arrangement (also: new remittance type, new depository, entity-name change, account change/closure)

title: Establish T&I custodial account (Form 1014)
trigger: On new arrangement (also: new sub-account for loss drafts / unapplied / buydown; depository change; entity-name change)

title: Monthly P&I reconciliation (Form 496)
trigger: Monthly per account & remittance type (plus a daily three-way reconciliation that feeds it)

title: T&I custodial reconciliation (Form 496A)
trigger: Monthly per T&I account (daily three-way engine feeds it)

title: Unidentified/unapplied funds management
trigger: Ongoing (event-driven on every unmatched or unapplied receipt; daily aging; weekly register review; monthly Form 496A line 4)

title: Periodic statement
deadline: Reasonably prompt after due date/courtesy period

title: ARM interest rate adjustment notice
deadline: 60–120 days before first adjusted payment (25–120 for frequently-adjusting, ≤60-day cycles)

title: Payoff statement
deadline: Within 7 business days (reasonable time if disaster)

title: Force-placed — reminder notice
deadline: ≥30 days after first notice AND ≥15 days before charge

title: Force-placed cancellation/refund
deadline: Cancel & refund overlapping premium within 15 days

title: Flood insurance / mandatory purchase
source: Flood Disaster Protection Act; FEMA NFHL

title: Property inspection (delinquent)
deadline: Order on/after 90th day, complete by 120th; continue monthly while 90+ delinquent

title: Borrower-requested cancellation @80% LTV
deadline: At 80% original value w/ good payment history (no 30+ late in 12 mo, no 60+ in 24 mo); no subordinate lien

title: Final termination @ midpoint
deadline: Month after midpoint (e.g., yr 15 of 30) even if >78%

title: Denial notice
deadline: Within 30 days of scheduled termination date

title: Live contact
deadline: Good-faith effort by 36th day of delinquency; again ≤36 days after each due date

title: Written early intervention notice
deadline: By 45th day of delinquency; again ≤45 days each cycle

title: Acknowledge loss-mit application
trigger: On receipt (any loss mitigation application, any channel; continuous)
deadline: ≤5 business days; state complete/incomplete + missing items

title: Complete-application evaluation
trigger: Complete app >37 days before sale (event-driven; also: no sale scheduled; facially complete applications; streamlined/servicer-initiated evaluations)
deadline: Evaluate all options + written decision within 30 days

title: Appeal handling
deadline: Decision within 30 days; ≥14 days for borrower to accept

title: Forbearance plan
trigger: On hardship (temporary, unresolved hardship after QRPC; disaster hardship without QRPC)
deadline: QRPC contact 10–45 days before plan end

title: Repayment plan
trigger: On cure path (hardship resolved; borrower cannot reinstate in full but can pay more than the contractual payment for a period)

title: Payment Deferral
trigger: Resolved hardship (borrower can resume the full contractual payment but cannot reinstate or afford a repayment plan; 2–6 months delinquent)
deadline: Solicit by 15th of following month if no QRPC; ≤12 mos cumulative deferred P&I over life

title: Disaster Payment Deferral
trigger: Disaster hardship (FEMA-declared disaster with Individual Assistance, insured loss, or employment in the disaster area; typically after a disaster forbearance)
deadline: Solicit within 15 days after forbearance expiration

title: Fannie Mae Flex Modification
trigger: On eligibility (permanent/long-term hardship, ≥60 days delinquent, or imminent default with a complete BRP; streamlined solicitation at day 90–105; post-forbearance/repayment/defer
deadline: Trial period; modification effective 1st day of month after trial; Form 3179 issued early enough

title: Short sale / Mortgage Release (DIL)
trigger: Liquidation path (retention options exhausted or borrower requests a liquidation option; permanent hardship; property to be sold or surrendered)

title: 120-day pre-foreclosure prohibition
deadline: No first notice/filing until borrower >120 days delinquent

title: Dual-tracking restriction
deadline: No foreclosure sale while complete app pending

title: Foreclosure referral
deadline: Refer by 120th day (non-principal residence) after prereferral review; foreclosure begins on referral date; record date in file

title: Allowable timeframes / compensatory fees
deadline: Per state allowable timeline; no compensatory fee for delays beyond servicer control if status codes timely/accurate

title: Environmental hazard / non-routine litigation
deadline: Do not begin foreclosure; notify Fannie Mae Legal immediately

title: SCRA foreclosure protection
deadline: Court order required; protection during service + 12 months

title: SCRA 6% interest cap
deadline: Reduce to 6% retroactive to active-duty start; excess forgiven

title: Remit payoff proceeds to Fannie Mae
Fannie Mae transfer approval
deadline: Per Fannie Mae; unauthorized transfers not recognized

title: Net-worth / liquidity eligibility
source: FHFA Seller/Servicer Min. Financial Eligibility (base net worth $2.5M + 25 bps of GSE servicing)

title: Records retention
deadline: Life-of-loan + minimum periods; Reg X ≥1 year after transfer/discharge
